# Is your requirements.txt actually reproducible?

> Paste your requirements.txt and see every unpinned version, missing hash, extra index URL and unpinned git dependency. Free pip requirements pin checker, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/requirements-pin-check/)
- [How to pin and hash Python dependencies](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/requirements-pin-check/pin-python-dependencies-guide.html)
